# Step - cyclic_path

`cyclic_path` · `cyclicPath` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps only traversers whose path visits some element twice.

## Forms

```text
cyclic_path()
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.v(1).out().in().cyclic_path().count().next()   // 3
```
